name: Bishop

abilityDetails.Persistent Power Meter: Güç barının dövüşler arasında kalıcı olmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kanama, şok veya yakma hasarlı şampiyon kullanma. Tech sınıfından yakmaya immün şampiyonlar ideal. Hem E1 hem E2 kaçılması zor, bloklamak tavsiye edilir.
signatureAbility:
Foresight
Bishop prepares a unique bonus based on how many bars of Power are full at the start of the fight.
With 0 Bars: Special Attacks become Unblockable with a stack of [30 - 10] or more Prowess.
With 1 Bar: While Blocking, gain Stun Immunity and enemies lose [10 - 80]% ability accuracy.
With 2 Bars: Special Attacks leave the target Incinerated for [10 - 70]% of the Special Damage dealt over 10 seconds.
With 3 Bars: Start the fight with Steady Release active for [3 - 15] seconds.

abilitySections.title: Persistent Power Meter
content: Bishop's mastery over energy and time enables him to enter a fight with 100% of the Power he finished his previous fight in the same Quest with.
Bishop's Special 1 and 2 Attacks cost no Power when activated. Instead, after these Specials end, Bishop immediately loses however many Bars of Power that special would have cost.

abilitySections.title: Always Active - Personal Prowess
content: All of Bishop's Personal Passive Prowess effects increase Special Attack Damage by 10%.

abilitySections.title: Always Active - Energy Transference
content: +[5,338.24] Energy Resistance.
Every 1 second(s), on receiving any Energy Damage gain 3 Passive Prowess.
Absorbing the kinetic energy of Blocking or being Struck generates 1 stack of Prowess, Well Time Blocks gain an additional +6 Prowess.
All these abilities grant +1 Prowess vs Skill Opponents, and -1 vs Tech.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: Holding Block for 0.5 seconds, Bishop converts 1 Personal Prowess into a Regeneration Buff every 0.33 seconds, granting [809.06] Health over 5 seconds. Max Stacks: 5.
Each Prowess converted also has an 100% chance to Purify a Bleed Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Always Active - Debuff Feedback
content: Each time the Opponent Purifies a Debuff they instantly receive [8,245.81] Energy Damage.
Skill Champions also receive a Passive Stun lasting 1.5 second(s) if the Debuff Purified was a Stun.

abilitySections.title: Warning: Power Overload!
content: While Bishop has more than 30 Prowess, or if he's Bleeding, Shocked, or Incinerated he Overloads and begins consuming his personal Prowess effects 1 at a time, getting faster the longer he's been Overloading.
If Bishop is suffering from a Bleed, Shock, or Incinerate, Debuff or Passive, each time he consumes a Prowess this way he also deals [2,063] Energy Damage to his Opponent, scaling with Base Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: After each Special Attack Bishop consumes all his Personal Prowess Passives.
If Bishop is Overloading go passively Unblockable for the Duration of the Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: After this Special Attack finishes, gain a Steady Release Passive for 10 seconds.
While active every 0.75 second(s) while near the opponent, inflict an Incinerate Debuff on them, dealing [3,352.38] Energy Damage over 3 seconds.
Each Prowess consumed by this attack increases the Duration of Steady Release by 2.5%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The last hit has a 100% chance to inflict an Incinerate Debuff lasting 10 seconds, and dealing 70% of the total damage dealt by this Special.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a non-stacking Energy Vulnerability reducing Energy Resistance by [1,668.38] for 20 seconds.
Against enemies at full Health, this Energy Vulnerability becomes indefinite.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Foresight
content: Bishop prepares a unique bonus based on how many bars of Power are full at the start of the fight.
With 0 Bars: Special Attacks become Unblockable with a stack of [30 - 10] or more Prowess.
With 1 Bar: While Blocking, gain Stun Immunity and enemies lose [10 - 80]% ability accuracy.
With 2 Bars: Special Attacks leave the target Incinerated for [10 - 70]% of the Special Damage dealt over 10 seconds.
With 3 Bars: Start the fight with Steady Release active for [3 - 15] seconds.
